Careem is led by a powerful purpose to simplify and improve the lives of people and build an awesome organisation that inspires. Since 2012, Careem has created earnings for over 2\.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of over 70 million customers, and built a platform for the region’s best talent to thrive and for entrepreneurs to scale their businesses. * Lead a 0\-1 AI transformation for Careem app from personalization perspective.

* 10\+ years of experience in data mining, predictive modeling, time series analysis, machine learning, LLM, Big Data methodologies, transformation and cleaning of both structured and unstructured data.
* Advanced degree in a quantitative discipline such as Physics, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering or Computer Science.
* Solid experience with Deep Learning Techniques (e.g attention, retrieval models, etc)
* 3\-4 years industrial experience in personalization, recommendation or search. Preferably working in a product driven company.
* LLM and GenAI experience
* Strong problem solving and coding skills.
* Solid knowledge of AB testing, classic ML and DL
* Solid understanding of recommendations, ranking and retrieval.
* Proficiency and demonstrated experience in: Python, SQL, Spark, Hive.
* Demonstrated experience with database technologies (e.g. Hadoop, BigQuery, Amazon EMR, Hive, Oracle, SAP, DB2, Teradata, MS SQL Server, MySQL).
* Demonstrated experience with business intelligence and visualization tools (Tableau, MicroStrategy, ChartIO, Qlik) along with geospatial data processing skills is a plus.

title: Senior AI Engineer, Quantitative Strategies
description:
OneBullEx is a crypto futures exchange startup built for speed, reliability, and innovation. Our platform delivers real\-time trading performance—even under extreme market volatility—powered by advanced automation and AI\-driven tools, including our "300 Spartans" trading bots. With cutting\-edge machine learning, a user\-first design, and transparent risk management, we are on a mission to redefine how traders navigate the fast\-moving world of digital assets.
   

  

**Job Overview**
 We are seeking a Senior AI Engineer, Quantitative Strategies to help pioneer a next\-generation, self\-evolving AI pipeline for trading strategy creation. This role goes beyond traditional engineering—you will architect an autonomous system that can generate, test, and refine its own strategies using the latest in large language models (LLMs) such as Gemini, ChatGPT, and Claude. If you are excited by the idea of making AI a true creative partner in quantitative trading, this is your chance to help shape the future of the industry.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Architect from the ground up an autonomous strategy generation and evaluation pipeline, making key technical decisions that will define its future
* Integrate and fine\-tune cutting\-edge LLMs to generate novel, testable trading hypotheses
* Build closed\-loop feedback systems to automate backtesting, analyze performance, and iteratively improve AI\-generated strategies
* Act as a bridge between quantitative research and AI engineering, working closely with traders and analysts to translate market insights into machine\-executable strategies
* Ensure scalability, performance, and robustness of all deployed systems


**Candidate Requirements**
* Advanced degree (Master's or Ph.D.) in Financial Engineering, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, or a related quantitative field
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in quantitative or software engineering roles, ideally within trading, fintech, or financial markets
* Strong proficiency in Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit\-learn) and experience with ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX)
* Solid knowledge of deep learning, reinforcement learning, and optimization techniques
* Experience with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, and preferably fine\-tuning
* Strong software engineering fundamentals, including Git, testing, and deployment workflows
* Deep understanding of financial markets, statistical analysis, and strategy development principles


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Proven track record of developing and executing trading strategies in live markets
* Recognition in quantitative competitions (e.g., Kaggle, Quantopian)
* GitHub or portfolio demonstrating complex, data\-driven projects
* Experience with reinforcement learning or other adaptive systems
* A strong intellectual curiosity and drive to push technological boundaries


**Why Join OneBullEx?**
* Early Impact – Be part of the founding team shaping a revolutionary AI\-driven trading ecosystem
* Innovation at Scale – Work with cutting\-edge AI, LLMs, and financial technology in a high\-growth startup
* Global Ambition – Contribute to a platform with plans for rapid international expansion
* Competitive Package – Attractive salary, performance\-based incentives, and relocation support to Dubai

 Location: Dubai, UAE
 



 Reports to: Head of Product / CEO
 



 Function: Product \& Technology – AI/ML Systems \& Automation
 



 Employment Type: Full\-time
 



  





 About Watermelon
 



 Watermelon is a fast\-scaling B2B food tech platform redefining supply chains across MENA. We integrate POS, CRM, marketplace, and embedded fintech into a unified, AI\-powered ecosystem serving thousands of suppliers and F\&B businesses. As we scale, our edge is intelligence — building interconnected systems that turn real\-world complexity into seamless automation. The Role We’re looking for a systems\-level thinker who designs end\-to\-end AI workflows, not just models. You will architect, build, and optimize intelligent systems that connect data, processes, and decision\-making across our platform. From credit scoring to dynamic inventory, you’ll own the entire lifecycle — from problem framing to deployment at scale — ensuring every piece of intelligence delivers measurable business impact.

 Systems Architecture \& AI Engineering
 



 ● Design and implement AI\-driven workflows for supply, demand, credit, and operations.
 



 ● Build scalable pipelines for ingestion, processing, and decision\-making across heterogeneous data sources.
 



 ● Develop interconnected services where models feed into automated actions — e.g., credit risk → onboarding workflow → CRM triggers.
 



 ● Apply MLOps best practices for continuous delivery, monitoring, and optimization of production models.
 



  





 Predictive \& Prescriptive Intelligence
 



 ● Build models for churn prediction, credit scoring (90%\+ accuracy), demand forecasting, and supplier performance tracking.
 



 ● Develop recommendation engines for product matching, upsell/cross\-sell logic, and order optimization.
 



 ● Implement explainable AI techniques to support financial compliance and trust.
 



  





 Automation \& Integration
 



 ● Integrate AI outputs directly into operational systems (Zoho One CRM, ERP, payments, logistics).
 



 ● Build event\-driven automation that reacts in real time (\<100ms latency) to business triggers.
 



 ● Develop self\-healing workflows that identify anomalies and adapt automatically.
 



  





 NLP \& Document Intelligence
 



 ● Deploy OCR \+ NLP systems to extract structured data from invoices, contracts, and onboarding documents.
 



 ● Build conversational and sentiment\-aware bots for supplier and customer engagement.
 



 ● Implement contract/risk intelligence systems for compliance monitoring.
 



  





 Platform Optimization
 



 ● Implement dynamic pricing and margin optimization frameworks.
 



 ● Deploy supply forecasting models that adjust inventory recommendations live.
 



 ● Set up automated anomaly detection across operational KPIs.
 



  





 Tech Stack You’ll Work With
 



 ● Languages: Python (must), Java/Node.js, SQL
 



 ● ML/AI: PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit\-learn, XGBoost
 



 ● NLP: spaCy, NLTK, OpenAI API, OCR frameworks
 



 ● Data \& Infra: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Kafka, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS/GCP
 



 ● Integrations: Zoho One (CRM, Creator, Deluge), REST APIs, webhooks
 



  





 What We’re Looking For
 



 ● 5\+ years in applied AI/ML engineering, with experience architecting end\-to\-end intelligent systems in SaaS, fintech, marketplaces, or supply chain tech.
 



 ● Proven track record designing production\-grade AI workflows that integrate with business operations.

* Gute Kenntnisse in der Nutzung relationaler Datenbanken und SQL
* Fundierte Erfahrungen mit Cloud\-Technologien (z.B. Azure, AWS)
* Erfahrung mit Big\-Data\-Technologien (z.B. Spark, Kafka) sowie Operationalisierungswerkzeugen (z.B. Docker, Kubernetes)
* Erfahrungen in DevOps/MLOps\-Prinzipien und \-Tools
* Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke in Deutsch und Englisch \- im Team und Kunden gegenüber
* Neugier und Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Reisen


 Sie haben bei uns vielfältige Möglichkeiten zur Weiterentwicklung und Übernahme von Verantwortung. **Mensch \& Kultur:** 
 Die Gemeinschaft und der Austausch im Unternehmen werden durch vielfältige Events wie Unternehmensmittagessen, Sommerfeste, Teamevents, Unternehmenskonferenzen und Weihnachtsfeiern aktiv gefördert.  Die Vielfalt unserer (Kunden\-)Projekte ermöglicht eine individuelle Karriereentwicklung. Verschiedenste Schulungsangebote und die Teilnahme an Fachkonferenzen fördern fachliches Wachstum.  Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Arbeitszeitkonto, Mobile Office/hybrides Arbeiten, Workation\-/Sabbatical\-Optionen und die Möglichkeit Hunde mit ins Büro zu bringen, sind nur ein Teil unseres Angebots für Flexibilität und Lebensqualität.  Mitarbeiter profitieren von unseren Zuschüssen für: Kinderbetreuung, Essen und Sport, betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit unverbindlicher Beratung, Deutschlandticket für nachhaltiges Reisen.

 Verschiedene Gesundheitsmaßnahmen wie bewegte Pausen, Ergonomieberatung, Grippeimpfung und Augenarztuntersuchung fördern das Wohlbefinden und die langfristige Gesundheit der Mitarbeiter. title: Associate Applied AI Engineer (DACH) - Orbit Program
description:
We're Celonis, the global leader in Process Mining technology and one of the world's fastest\-growing SaaS firms. We believe there is a massive opportunity to unlock productivity by placing data and intelligence at the core of business processes \- and for that, we need you to join us.
   

  

**Location: Madrid for an onboarding period of 2 years and a planned relocation to Munich/Zurich after. Customer base will be in the DACH region, involving travel to meet clients in person.**
**The Team**
 As an Associate Applied AI Engineer, you are part of our Value Engineering team and are the trusted advisor for customers working on the intersection of technology and business. As a so\-called Value Engineer (VE), you partner with sales and customers to create compelling and innovative technical solutions to critical business problems leveraging cutting edge (AI) capabilities within our Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. A great VE understands the customer, the technology, and the sales cycle making it what may be the most interesting, challenging, and fulfilling role in Enterprise Software
   

  

 You will be joining the Global VE Center of Excellence which is an international, diverse, and dynamic organization at the core of the Celonis Value Engineering team supporting our local field teams. As a team, we enjoy working in a fast\-paced environment and share a sense of belonging to a community that wants to learn and grow together. The team culture is one based on building trust, continuous development, and improvement through coaching \& mentoring.
   

  

**The Role**
 Talented individuals launch their careers in the enterprise software world by joining the Orbit Graduate Program as an Associate Value Engineer.
   

  

 The
 **12\-month program** 
 is a unique experience to fast start your career in the SaaS Industry that highlights hands\-on learning, mentorship, and a team culture where we rely on each other to learn, grow and achieve. The program is designed to develop essential VE skills \& competencies and establish strong lasting relationships allowing you to grow your career at Celonis.
   

  

 Your journey will start with onboarding \& enablement to develop your business and Celonis skills through a combination of hands\-on experience in customer engagements and different pieces of training which cover amongst others the Celonis Process Intelligence, domain knowledge, presentation \& demo skills, discovery \& objection handling as well as value selling.
   

  

**The work you’ll do:**
* Work as part of the Global VE CoE to support the DACH Value Engineering team on customer engagements
* Collaborate with customers to uncover their core business challenges and determine how Celonis Process Intelligence can help them achieve their business objectives and AI Strategy
* Execute proof projects showcasing the value of Celonis Process Intelligence, frame a quantitative business value and deliver presentations to senior executives to drive investment decisions
* Prototype and develop AI solutions tailored to customer needs, including both traditional machine learning, LLM\-based solutions and orchestration technology
* Drive change management and value realisation and ensure a positive return on investment
* Build strong relationships with our customers by winning their trust through technical, product expertise, and business acumen to act as a trusted advisor
* Collaborate and share customer insights \& feedback with internal Product and Engineering teams to influence and co\-develop (AI) product innovations
* Create re\-usable collateral, best practices \& tools within the Global VE Center of Excellence and feed them back to the regional Value Engineering team
* Travel to the DACH region to meet clients in person to ensure the success of customer engagements


**The qualifications you need:**
 We are looking for people who enjoy solving problems, think outside the box, and are not afraid to make and learn from mistakes. In particular, we seek “builders” who thrive in fast\-paced environments and can rapidly develop solutions and pilots using our platform and AI technologies.
   

  

 You have a bachelors and/or masters degree in (Industrial) Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science / Business Analytics, AI/ML, Mathematics or other related fields, as well as valuable work/internship experience. You’re curious, self\-motivated, enjoy continuous learning, and you want to work in a lively environment characterized by high growth.
   

  

**You are successful as a Value Engineer if you:**
* Have a passion for technology, data and AI and the impact it can have on the world
* Have a hunger to learn new technologies and bring at least basic knowledge or hands\-on experience in SQL and/or Python
* Any exposure to process mining principles and completion of Celonis Rising Star modules would be a welcome indicator of your eagerness to develop in this field
* Are able to think analytically and creatively, especially in applying technology solutions to core business problems
* Are focused on creating and adding value for customers
* Have an entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to multi\-task, prioritize and execute
* Are able to build relationships with senior management and influence decision\-makers
* Are confident to present to C\-level executives and larger audiences
* Are willing to travel to the DACH region to meet clients in person
* Are an effective communicator and fluent in German and English.


**What Celonis Can Offer You:**
* Pioneer Innovation: Work with the leading, award\-winning process mining technology, shaping the future of business.
* Accelerate Your Growth: Benefit from clear career paths, internal mobility, a dedicated learning program, and mentorship opportunities.
* Receive Exceptional Benefits: Including generous PTO, hybrid working options, company equity (RSUs), comprehensive benefits, extensive parental leave, dedicated volunteer days, and much more. Interns and working students explore your benefits here.
* Prioritize Your Well\-being: Access to resources such as gym subsidies, counseling, and well\-being programs.
* Connect and Belong: Find community and support through dedicated inclusion and belonging programs.
* Make Meaningful Impact: Be part of a company driven by strong values that guide everything we do: Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future.
* Collaborate Globally: Join a dynamic, international team of talented individuals.
* Empowered Environment: Contribute your ideas in an open culture with autonomous teams.


**About Us:**
 Celonis makes processes work for people, companies and the planet. The Celonis Process Intelligence Platform uses industry\-leading process mining and AI technology and augments it with business context to give customers a living digital twin of their business operation. It’s system\-agnostic and without bias, and provides everyone with a common language for understanding and improving businesses. Celonis enables its customers to continuously realize significant value across the top, bottom, and green line. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.
   

  

 Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.
   

  

**Celonis Inclusion Statement:**
 At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard \- that's when creativity and innovation happen.
   

  

**Your Privacy:**
 Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices
   

  

 By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

description:

TetraScience is the Scientific Data and AI Cloud company. We are catalyzing the Scientific AI revolution by designing and industrializing AI\-native scientific data sets, which we bring to life in a growing suite of next gen lab data management solutions, scientific use cases, and AI\-enabled outcomes.

You are a **product\-minded, outcome\-obsessed** driver of technical scientific solutions.

You thrive in environments where **you can collaborate with scientists, product managers, and engineers** to transform complex scientific data into actionable outcomes. Your ability to engage with scientists and business leaders alike makes you a key player in maximizing the value of scientific data.


With rich experience applying cutting edge data methodologies to the biopharma R\&D domain, you bridge understanding between present\-day pain points and generalizable solutions.


You are an **insatiable learner**, with a track record of deeply learning new tools, methods, and domains.


You fundamentally embody the principles of extreme ownership and have a demonstrated history of building extensible data models and applications for Biopharma end users to maximize value from their data via analysis and integration with AI/ML.


This role will require extreme self\-discipline and determination as we forge a category that will fundamentally and forever change the life science industry.

### **What You Have Done**

* **PhD with 7\+ years / Masters with 10\+ years of industry experience in life sciences** with extensive domain knowledge in drug discovery (target ID through lead optimization), preclinical development, CMC (all drug modalities), or product quality testing.
* Proven track record of defining, designing, prototyping, and implementing productized AI/ML\-driven use cases in cloud environments
* Collaborated with cross\-functional teams, including product managers, software engineers, and scientific stakeholders.
* Performed extensive exploratory data analysis and workflow optimization to enable scientific outcomes not previously possible.
* Engaged diverse audiences, from scientists to executive stakeholders using your excellent communication and storytelling abilities.
* Advised scientists in a consulting capacity to further research, development, and quality testing outcomes.

* **You will be a critical team member in a unique partnership to industrialize Scientific AI**. As such, you will **engage directly with customers onsite a couple of days per week in the Frankfurt Region,** building strong relationships, deeply understanding their scientific data challenges and requirements, and accelerating solutions.
* **Design and implement extensible, reusable data models** that efficiently capture and organize scientific data for scientific use cases, ensuring scalability and future adaptability.
* Translate scientific data workflows into robust solutions leveraging the Tetra Data Platform.
* Own, scope, prototype, and implement solutions including:
* + Data model design (tabular \& JSON)
	+ Python\-based parser development.
	+ Lab software (e.g., ELN/LIMS) integration via APIs.
	+ Data visualization and app development in Python (using app frameworks like Streamlit and plotting tools like holoviews and Plotly)
	+ Collaborate with Scientific Business Analysts (SBAs), customer scientists and applied AI engineers to develop and deploy models (ML, AI, mechanistic, statistical, hybrid)
	+ Programmatically interrogating proprietary instrument output files.
* Dynamically iterate with scientific end users and technical stakeholders to rapidly drive solution development and adoption through regular demos and meetings
* Proactively communicate implementation progress and deliver demos to customer stakeholders.
* Collaborate with the product team to build and prioritize our roadmap by understanding customers’ pain points within and outside Tetra Data Platform.
* Rapidly learn new technologies (e.g., new AWS services or scientific analysis applications) to develop and troubleshoot use cases

**Benefits**

* Competitive Salary and equity in a fast\-growing company.
* Supportive, team\-oriented culture of continuous improvement.
* Generous paid time off (PTO).

Flexible working arrangements \- Remote work when not at Customer Sites

* Starke Kenntnisse in Modellarchitekturen (Transformer, RNN, Hybrid\-Ansätze)

* Hintergrund in akustischer Signalverarbeitung, prosodischer Analyse und Sprachausgabequalität

title: Agentic AI Engineer
description:
AUG 12, 2025**Shape the Future of AI\-Driven Autonomy with VML MAP Agentic Labs**

Are you passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI technology? Do you want to build next\-generation agentic AI systems that go beyond traditional automation and redefine human\+AI collaboration? If so, join our Agentic AI Lab, where you'll work at the cutting edge of multi\-agent architectures, autonomous workflows, and AI reasoning systems.


**About VML MAP Agentic Labs**

At VML MAP, we are investing in the future by leading the way in agentic AI development. Over the past year, we’ve built VML MAP Agentic Labs, a four\-pronged initiative focused on designing, building, and implementing agentic AI solutions that drive real business value for ourselves and our clients.



Our labs include:


**Agentic Design Lab** – A product centric function responsible for uncovering and designing value\-driven agentic AI opportunities that are feasible, viable, and deliverable.


**Agentic Development Lab** – A best\-in\-class agentic platform and development practice, delivering multi\-agent workflows with rapid, outcome\-driven iterations and long\-term adoption strategies.


**Agentic Research Lab** – Focused on agentic architecture, human\+AI workflows and enabling fast, well\-founded development decisions with deep methodology research.


**Agentic Tooling Lab** – Ensuring market\-ready AI and agentic solutions are optimized for adoption and effectiveness instead of reinventing existing tools.


As an Agentic AI Engineer, you will directly contribute to this initiative, working alongside AI researchers, engineers, and business stakeholders to create scalable and impactful AI solutions.


What will your day look like?



As part of the Agentic AI Lab, you’ll be at the forefront of designing, developing, and optimizing intelligent multi\-agent systems that tackle complex, real\-world challenges.



Your responsibilities will include:


* Designing, developing and deploying multi\-agent AI systems
* Building and optimizing agentic workflows for real\-world applications that enhance decision\-making and operational efficiency.
* Collaborating across teams—from AI engineers to business architects—to conceptualize and implement cutting\-edge AI solutions.
* Refining agentic reasoning steps, process logging, and system performance to ensure robust, explainable, and scalable agent behaviour.
* Architecting and deploying agentic AI solutions while ensuring scalability, reliability, and ethical considerations.
* Contributing to the strategic direction of the Agentic AI Lab by identifying new opportunities for agentic applications.
* Defining and documenting design processes, system architectures, and best practices for knowledge\-sharing and future development.
* Staying up to date with the latest advancements in agentic AI and incorporate cutting\-edge techniques into development workflows.

What do you bring to the table?



We’re looking for someone who’s both highly technical and deeply curious, with a passion for exploring the frontiers of AI autonomy.



You should have:


* Strong expertise in agentic AI and foundation models, ideally with experience developing and testing multi\-agent systems.
* Experience and learnings using agentic frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, SmolAgents, and AutoGen.
* Hands\-on experience deploying AI/ML systems in production, preferably agentic/multi\-agent settings.
* Proficiency in programming languages, such as Python (Must), Java (or similar languages), with a focus in AI/ML frameworks.
* Deep understanding of agentic AI concepts, including reasoning processes, process logging, optimisation, reinforcement learning, autonomous systems, and distributed AI.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) for scalable deployments.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and GitOps for automated build, test, and deployment workflows.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to translate complex requirements into practical solutions.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively in interdisciplinary teams.

It is a plus if you have experience with:


* Publications or open\-source contributions in agentic AI, multi\-agent systems, or autonomous AI.
* Understanding ethical considerations and best practices in deploying AI systems.

Why join us?


* Work at the cutting edge of agentic AI—beyond chatbots, we’re building real\-world AI\-driven autonomy.
* Be part of a dynamic and innovative team at the forefront of AI research and development.
* Make an impact—your work will directly shape the future of AI\-driven collaboration and automation.
* Grow your expertise in one of AI’s fastest\-growing fields, with opportunities for professional development.
* Competitive salary and benefits in a forward\-thinking and supportive environment.

**Join us in defining the next era of intelligent AI agents!**



A leader in personalized customer experiences



VML MAP is a world\-leading Centre of Excellence that helps businesses humanize the relationship between the brand and the customer through hyper personalization at scale, marketing automation and CRM. With the brain of a consultancy, the heart of an agency and the power of technology and data, we work with some of the world's most admired brands to help them on their transformation journey to becoming truly customer\-centric. Together, we are 1000 \+ technology specialists, data scientists, strategic thinkers, consultants, operations experts, and creative minds from 55\+ nationalities.



A global network



We are part of the global VML network that encompasses more than 30,000 employees across 150\+ offices in 60\+ markets, each contributing to a culture that values connection, belonging, and the power of differences.

WPP (VML MAP) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

title: Associate Applied AI Engineer (MENA) - Orbit Program
description:
We're Celonis, the global leader in Process Mining technology and one of the world's fastest\-growing SaaS firms. We believe there is a massive opportunity to unlock productivity by placing data and intelligence at the core of business processes \- and for that, we need you to join us.
   

  

**Location:** 
**Madrid** 
 for a period of 2 years and a planned relocation to Middle East and North Africa region after.
 **Customer base will be in the Middle East and North Africa region, involving travel to meet clients in person.**
**The Team**
 As an Applied AI Engineer, you are part of our Value Engineering team and are the trusted advisor for customers working on the intersection of technology and business. As a so\-called Value Engineer (VE), you partner with sales and customers to create compelling and innovative technical solutions to critical business problems leveraging cutting edge (AI) capabilities within our Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. A great VE understands the customer, the technology, and the sales cycle making it what may be the most interesting, challenging, and fulfilling role in Enterprise Software
   

  

 You will be joining the Global VE Center of Excellence which is an international, diverse, and dynamic organization at the core of the Celonis Value Engineering team supporting our local field teams. As a team, we enjoy working in a fast\-paced environment and share a sense of belonging to a community that wants to learn and grow together. The team culture is one based on building trust, continuous development, and improvement through coaching \& mentoring.
   

  

**The Role**
 Talented individuals launch their careers in the enterprise software world by joining the Orbit Graduate Program as an Associate Value Engineer.
   

  

 The
 **12\-month program** 
 is a unique experience to fast start your career in the SaaS Industry that highlights hands\-on learning, mentorship, and a team culture where we rely on each other to learn, grow and achieve. The program is designed to develop essential VE skills \& competencies and establish strong lasting relationships allowing you to grow your career at Celonis.
   

  

 Your journey will start with onboarding \& enablement to develop your business and Celonis skills through a combination of hands\-on experience in customer engagements and different pieces of training which cover amongst others the Celonis Process Intelligence, domain knowledge, presentation \& demo skills, discovery \& objection handling as well as value selling.
   

  

**The work you’ll do:**
* Work as part of the Global VE CoE to support the MENA Value Engineering team on customer engagements
* Collaborate with customers to uncover their core business challenges and determine how Celonis Process Intelligence can help them achieve their business objectives and AI Strategy
* Execute proof projects showcasing the value of Celonis Process Intelligence, frame a quantitative business value and deliver presentations to senior executives to drive investment decisions
* Prototype and develop AI solutions tailored to customer needs, including both traditional machine learning, LLM\-based solutions and orchestration technology
* Drive change management and value realisation and ensure a positive return on investment
* Build strong relationships with our customers by winning their trust through technical, product expertise, and business acumen to act as a trusted advisor
* Collaborate and share customer insights \& feedback with internal Product and Engineering teams to influence and co\-develop (AI) product innovations
* Create re\-usable collateral, best practices \& tools within the Global VE Center of Excellence and feed them back to the regional Value Engineering team
* Travel to the MENA region to meet clients in person to ensure the success of customer engagements


**The qualifications you need:**
 We are looking for people who enjoy solving problems, think outside the box, and are not afraid to make and learn from mistakes. In particular, we seek “builders” who thrive in fast\-paced environments and can rapidly develop solutions and pilots using our platform and AI technologies.
   

  

 You have a bachelors and/or masters degree in (Industrial) Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science / Business Analytics, AI/ML, Mathematics or other related fields, as well as valuable work/internship experience. You’re curious, self\-motivated, enjoy continuous learning, and you want to work in a lively environment characterized by high growth.
   

  

**You are successful as a Value Engineer if you:**
* Have a passion for technology, data and AI and the impact it can have on the world
* Have a hunger to learn new technologies and bring at least basic knowledge or hands\-on experience in SQL and/or Python
* Any exposure to process mining principles and completion of Celonis Rising Star modules would be a welcome indicator of your eagerness to develop in this field
* Are able to think analytically and creatively, especially in applying technology solutions to core business problems
* Are focused on creating and adding value for customers
* Have an entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to multi\-task, prioritize and execute
* Are able to build relationships with senior management and influence decision\-makers
* Are confident to present to C\-level executives and larger audiences
* Are willing to travel to the MENA region to meet clients in person
* Are an effective communicator and fluent in English and Arabic, French is nice to have.


**What Celonis Can Offer You:**
* Pioneer Innovation: Work with the leading, award\-winning process mining technology, shaping the future of business.
* Accelerate Your Growth: Benefit from clear career paths, internal mobility, a dedicated learning program, and mentorship opportunities.
* Receive Exceptional Benefits: Including generous PTO, hybrid working options, company equity (RSUs), comprehensive benefits, extensive parental leave, dedicated volunteer days, and much more. Interns and working students explore your benefits here.
* Prioritize Your Well\-being: Access to resources such as gym subsidies, counseling, and well\-being programs.
* Connect and Belong: Find community and support through dedicated inclusion and belonging programs.
* Make Meaningful Impact: Be part of a company driven by strong values that guide everything we do: Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future.
* Collaborate Globally: Join a dynamic, international team of talented individuals.
* Empowered Environment: Contribute your ideas in an open culture with autonomous teams.


**About Us:**
 Celonis makes processes work for people, companies and the planet. The Celonis Process Intelligence Platform uses industry\-leading process mining and AI technology and augments it with business context to give customers a living digital twin of their business operation. It’s system\-agnostic and without bias, and provides everyone with a common language for understanding and improving businesses. Celonis enables its customers to continuously realize significant value across the top, bottom, and green line. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.
   

  

 Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.
   

  

**Celonis Inclusion Statement:**
 At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard \- that's when creativity and innovation happen.
   

  

**Your Privacy:**
 Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices
   

  

 By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.
   

  

 Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more here.

description:
This role is based in Barcelona, with an on\-site commitment of three days a week. Fluency in English is required.


Are you ready to make a significant impact at the crossroads of business and technology? As an Associate Director, Data Products for the Operational Data domain, you will be instrumental in shaping the clinical data landscape within a dynamic, cross\-functional organization. Reporting directly to the Data Product Owner, you will bridge technical and business requirements, enabling reliable insights for forecasting, planning, and strategic decision\-making. This is your chance to influence high\-impact deliverables for R\&D and Supply Chain leadership while collaborating with teams in Big Data, advanced analytics, and healthcare technology. Your efforts will ensure that End\-to\-End Clinical Planning is supported by high\-quality, consistent, and well\-integrated data products, driving operational excellence across the drug development lifecycle.

**Accountabilities**

* Analyse and translate business requirements from Clinical Planning, R\&D, and Supply Chain into actionable data needs.
* Evaluate compatibility of new requests with the existing reporting and analytics landscape.
* Ensure alignment and consistency in definitions, KPIs, and reporting methodologies across business functions.
* Map, document, and validate complex data flows from multiple internal source systems.
* Evaluate and improve data quality, identifying embedded business rules.
* Partner with Data Governance to establish and maintain data dictionaries, business glossaries, and metadata repositories.
* Collaborate with the Programme Transformation Team, Power BI developers, and ML/AI engineers.
* Support the development, testing, and deployment of analytical tools, algorithms, and dashboards.
* Drive cross\-functional workshops to align business, technical, and governance priorities.
* Ensure compliance with internal governance, regulatory, security, and quality standards.
* Proactively identify data gaps and recommend improvements.
* Facilitate collaboration across business and technical functions to support change management.
* Promote a culture of data\-driven decision\-making across Clinical Operations, R\&D, and Supply Chain.

**Essential Skills/Experience**

* University degree in Business Administration, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Biotechnology, Statistics, or a related field
* Experience in mapping business requirements to technical solutions and documentation
* Proven experience in business/data analysis roles within pharmaceutical, health sciences, or life sciences environments
* Strong technical acumen, with an understanding of data engineering principles, ETL processes, and data modelling concepts
* Proficiency in gathering and documenting technical requirements, data mapping, user stories, and process flows
* Strong analytical skills, business acumen, and the ability to communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholder groups
* Proficiency in English (spoken and written)

**Desirable Skills/Experience**

* Familiarity with enterprise data platforms (Starburst, Snowflake)
* Familiarity with data visualization tools such as Power BI or similar
* Jira and Confluence knowledge
* Basic knowledge of SQL, data querying, and data manipulation
* Understanding of operational data management principles and methodologies
* Knowledge of data governance, data quality management, and regulatory requirements for healthcare data


When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life\-changing medicines. In\-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.


At AstraZeneca, we are committed to making a difference by fusing data and technology with scientific innovations to achieve breakthroughs. Our inclusive environment encourages curiosity and courage to explore new possibilities. We unite diverse global knowledge to create swift impacts on disease. With opportunities for continuous learning and growth, this is a place where exploration thrives. Join us as we push the boundaries of science to deliver life\-changing medicines.


Ready to take on this exciting challenge? Apply now to become part of our team!

**About BSC**
 The Barcelona Supercomputing Center \- Centro Nacional de Supercomputación (BSC\-CNS) is the leading supercomputing center in Spain.
   

  

 It houses MareNostrum, one of the most powerful supercomputers in Europe, was a founding and hosting member of the former European HPC infrastructure PRACE (Partnership for Advanced Computing in Europe), and is now hosting entity for EuroHPC JU, the Joint Undertaking that leads large\-scale investments and HPC provision in Europe.
   

  

 The mission of BSC is to research, develop and manage information technologies in order to facilitate scientific progress.
   

  

 BSC combines HPC service provision and R\&D into both computer and computational science (life, earth and engineering sciences) under one roof, and currently has over 1000 staff from 60 countries.
   

  

 Look At The BSC Experience
   

  

 BSC\-CNS YouTube Channel

 Context And Mission
   

  

 Our group at the Life Sciences Department is developing a research line centred on the development and maintenance of research infrastructures to serve large\-scale projects in the Life Sciences domain.
   

  

 In this context, on one hand BioExcel Center of Excellence () is a project seeking to establish a stable infrastructure for software management in the field of Biomolecular simulations; on the other hand the MDDB project () is developing the initial establishment of a large scale federated repository for biomolecular simulations.
   

  

 The candidate is expected to have a strong involvement in the development of the core technical infrastructure for MDDB and the provision of advanced tools for simulation study including both traditional and AI based strategies.

 Knowledge of data and database management (NoSQL)
   

  

**Additional Knowledge And Professional Experience**
 Knowledge of software quality practices
   

  

 Knowledge of biomolecular simulation (MD) and structural bioinformatics

 Fluency in both written and spoken English

description:
In BETWEEN we offer you the opportunities you need to achieve your professional goals. If you want to develop your skills in IT and Engineering, this is your next destination!
   

  

 We support a wide variety of areas such as Firmware, Software, BI, Design, Project Management, and much more. Additionally, we develop tailor\-made technological solutions from our BETWEEN Labs.

**Functions**
 As an AI Engineer, you'll contribute to the development of a robust execution layer where AI models can run verifiably and confidentially. This role bridges applied cryptography, secure ML inference, and systems\-level programming to build a foundation for trusted AI.
   

  

 You’ll work on technologies like Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE), Zero\-Knowledge Machine Learning (ZKML), and advanced cryptographic protocols such as zkSNARKs—integrating these into our AI OS. Expect hands\-on work in Rust and Python, deep exploration of mathematical and cryptographic constructs, and close collaboration with research, hardware, and runtime teams. * Design and implement FHE\-based inference pipelines using libraries like Zama’s Concrete; assess performance and potential integrations.
* Prototype zero\-knowledge proof (ZKP) systems to verify AI model execution using tooling such as Circom, ezkl, Halo2, or zkVM environments.
* Take part in defining and building our client’s composable architecture for verifiable and privacy\-respecting machine learning.
* Write and optimize Rust and Python libraries to compile, execute, and verify ML models within secure execution contexts.
* Develop APIs and backend services for cryptographic inference and proof generation; contribute to PoC integrations for real\-world deployments.
* Interface with compiler and runtime teams to ensure smooth integration of secure ML components into the broader AI OS.

The Department for Science, Innovation and Technology (DSIT) is seeking an exceptional leader to become the Director of the Incubator for AI (i.AI), a flagship team within the Government Digital Service (GDS). This is a unique opportunity to lead a high\-performing, mission\-driven team that is building AI tools to transform public services and improve lives across the UK.


As Director, you will act as the CEO of i.AI, responsible for setting strategic direction, overseeing delivery, and ensuring the team thrives within government. You will report to the Director General for Digital Centre Design and play a key role in shaping the future of AI in the public sector.


i.AI is a technical unit which sets the precedent for how the government should harness AI. It possesses a rare concentration of talent and autonomy, with engineers from places like GCHQ, Faculty and Astrazeneca.  

  

Major successes include:

* **Extract**: an AI planning tool to be rolled out to all local authorities next year, launched by the Prime Minister at London Tech Week and praised by Sir Demis Hassabis for its intelligent use of DeepMind's Gemini and
* **Consult**: a consultation analysis tool, strengthening the democratic process, which is already saving time and money across government consultations


With government at the foothills of transformative AI, i.AI works at the frontier to ensure the public sector can reap its benefits.

### **Job description**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the strategic direction and delivery of i.AI’s portfolio, ensuring alignment with ministerial priorities and emerging technologies.
* Inspire and manage a multidisciplinary team of around 80 staff, including AI engineers, product managers and designers.
* Champion innovation methods and best practices in rapid prototyping and technical delivery.
* Represent i.AI at senior levels across government, including with Ministers and senior officials.
* Build partnerships with UK AI companies, academia and the wider public sector to scale impact.
* Ensure responsible and ethical AI development, embedding fairness, transparency and public trust in all products.

We are looking for a strategic, empowering and technically credible leader who can:

* Deliver complex transformation through new technologies in large\-scale environments.
* Lead diverse, high\-performing teams through change.
* Communicate technical concepts clearly to a wide range of audiences.
* Build coalitions and influence across government and industry.
* Demonstrate deep knowledge of AI technologies and their practical applications.
* Develop and implement governance frameworks that prioritise fairness, accountability and transparency.

  

Experience in leading AI start\-ups, incubators or venture\-style teams is desirable but not essential.

------------


Alongside your salary of £100,000, Government Digital Service contributes £28,970 towards you being a member of the Civil Service Defined Benefit Pension scheme. Find out what benefits a Civil Service Pension provides.
There are many benefits of working at GDS, including:

* flexible hybrid working with flexi\-time and the option to work part\-time or condensed hours
* a Civil Service Pension with an average employer contribution of 28\.97%
* 25 days of annual leave, increasing by a day each year up to a maximum of 30 days
* an extra day off for the King’s birthday
* an in\-year bonus scheme to recognise high performance
* career progression and coaching, including a training budget for personal development
* paid volunteering leave
* a focus on wellbeing with access to an employee assistance programme
* job satisfaction from making government services easier to use and more inclusive for people across the UK

DSIT does not normally offer full home working (i.e. working at home); but we do offer a variety of flexible working options (including occasionally working from home).

description:

JAAQ (Just Ask A Question) is a pioneering mental health platform that leverages interactive video technology and AI to provide users with access to insights from world\-leading experts and individuals with lived experiences. * 6\+ years of experience as a software engineer, with at least 2\+ years in a **technical leadership** role.
* A strong track record in delivery of world\-class **mobile apps** using **React Native**, with a strong focus on user experience.
* Backend development experience with **Node.js**, including RESTful API design and integration, including exposure to **AI/LLM technologies** or integrating ML\-powered features.

* Experience with regulatory audits (e.g., ISO 27001, DCB0129/0136\).

* Be part of a mission\-driven organisation making a tangible difference in mental health accessibility.
* Collaborate with a passionate, innovative, and supportive team.
* Opportunity to shape the content landscape of a rapidly growing platform.
* Competitive compensation, outstanding benefits package and equity options \- a chance to own the future of JAAQ.

Are you passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI technology? Do you want to build next\-generation agentic AI systems that go beyond traditional automation and redefine human\+AI collaboration? If so, join our Agentic AI Lab, where you'll work at the cutting edge of multi\-agent architectures, autonomous workflows, and AI reasoning systems.


**About VML MAP Agentic Labs**


At VML MAP, we are investing in the future by leading the way in agentic AI development. Over the past year, we’ve built VML MAP Agentic Labs, a four\-pronged initiative focused on designing, building, and implementing agentic AI solutions that drive real business value for ourselves and our clients. Our labs include:


**Agentic Design Lab** – A product centric function responsible for uncovering and designing value\-driven agentic AI opportunities that are feasible, viable, and deliverable.

**Agentic Tooling Lab** – Ensuring market\-ready AI and agentic solutions are optimized for adoption and effectiveness instead of reinventing existing tools.


As an Agentic AI Engineer, you will directly contribute to this initiative, working alongside AI researchers, engineers, and business stakeholders to create scalable and impactful AI solutions.


What will your day look like?



As part of the Agentic AI Lab, you’ll be at the forefront of designing, developing, and optimizing intelligent multi\-agent systems that tackle complex, real\-world challenges.



Your responsibilities will include:


* Designing, developing and deploying multi\-agent AI systems
* Building and optimizing agentic workflows for real\-world applications that enhance decision\-making and operational efficiency.
* Collaborating across teams—from AI engineers to business architects—to conceptualize and implement cutting\-edge AI solutions.
* Refining agentic reasoning steps, process logging, and system performance to ensure robust, explainable, and scalable agent behaviour.
* Architecting and deploying agentic AI solutions while ensuring scalability, reliability, and ethical considerations.
* Contributing to the strategic direction of the Agentic AI Lab by identifying new opportunities for agentic applications.
* Defining and documenting design processes, system architectures, and best practices for knowledge\-sharing and future development.
* Staying up to date with the latest advancements in agentic AI and incorporate cutting\-edge techniques into development workflows.

What do you bring to the table?



We’re looking for someone who’s both highly technical and deeply curious, with a passion for exploring the frontiers of AI autonomy.



You should have:


* Strong expertise in agentic AI and foundation models, ideally with experience developing and testing multi\-agent systems.
* Experience and learnings using agentic frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, SmolAgents, and AutoGen.
* Hands\-on experience deploying AI/ML systems in production, preferably agentic/multi\-agent settings.
* Proficiency in programming languages, such as Python (Must), Java (or similar languages), with a focus in AI/ML frameworks.
* Deep understanding of agentic AI concepts, including reasoning processes, process logging, optimisation, reinforcement learning, autonomous systems, and distributed AI.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) for scalable deployments.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and GitOps for automated build, test, and deployment workflows.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to translate complex requirements into practical solutions.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively in interdisciplinary teams.

It is a plus if you have experience with:


* Publications or open\-source contributions in agentic AI, multi\-agent systems, or autonomous AI.
* Understanding ethical considerations and best practices in deploying AI systems.

Why join us?


* Work at the cutting edge of agentic AI—beyond chatbots, we’re building real\-world AI\-driven autonomy.
* Be part of a dynamic and innovative team at the forefront of AI research and development.
* Make an impact—your work will directly shape the future of AI\-driven collaboration and automation.
* Grow your expertise in one of AI’s fastest\-growing fields, with opportunities for professional development.
* Competitive salary and benefits in a forward\-thinking and supportive environment.

**Join us in defining the next era of intelligent AI agents!**



A leader in personalized customer experiences



VML MAP is a world\-leading Centre of Excellence that helps businesses humanize the relationship between the brand and the customer through hyper personalization at scale, marketing automation and CRM. With the brain of a consultancy, the heart of an agency and the power of technology and data, we work with some of the world's most admired brands to help them on their transformation journey to becoming truly customer\-centric. **Requirements**


Basic Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or related field.

* Knowledge of containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes.

* Passion for innovation and continuous learning in AI, especially in generative and agentic AI.

* 25 days annual leave \+ 2 company days
* Health Insurance
* Pension Contribution
* ESOP
* Tax saver scheme

* Passion for Prenuvo's mission and a strong commitment to improving healthcare through AI\-driven innovation and research.

title: Développeur ou Développeuse en IA générative / plateforme Power
description:
**Aperçu**
 Chez KPMG, vous ferez partie d’une équipe diversifiée et dévouée de professionnels de la résolution de problèmes ayant un objectif commun traduire l’information en occasions pour nos clients et nos communautés partout dans le monde.
   

  

 Nous sommes à la recherche d’une personne dynamique et dotée du sens des affaires pour se joindre à notre équipe à titre de développeur ou développeuse en IA générative / plateforme Power. Ce rôle met l’accent sur le développement d’agents d’IA et d’agents Copilot à l’aide d’outils comme Copilot Studio et Azure OpenAI. La personne idéale comblera l’écart entre les besoins du cabinet et les solutions techniques en jouant un rôle hybride qui combine des connaissances en développement à la gestion de projet et à l’engagement des parties prenantes.
   

  

**Ce que vous ferez**
* Concevoir et intégrer des capacités d’IA générative et des solutions agentiques telles que des agents d’IA à l’aide de Copilot Studio, de la plateforme Power de Microsoft et d’outils connexes
* Développer et gérer des connecteurs, des API et des intégrations d’IA personnalisées à l’aide de systèmes d’entreprise, notamment ServiceNow et d’Agent Studio de Moveworks
* Concevoir, développer et déployer des solutions à l’aide de la plateforme Power de Microsoft (Power Apps, Power Automate, AI Builder)
* Collaborer avec les parties prenantes du cabinet pour recueillir, interpréter et traduire les exigences en solutions d’automatisation intelligente
* Prendre en charge le cycle de vie complet de la solution, de l’idéation et du prototypage au déploiement et à la maintenance
* Veiller à ce que les solutions soient sécurisées, évolutives et conformes aux normes d’architecture d’entreprise


**Ce que vous apportez au rôle**
* Diplôme en sciences informatiques ou formation équivalente.
* Solides compétences en relations interpersonnelles et en communication, et capacité d’interagir avec des utilisateurs professionnels et des équipes techniques.
* Passion pour l’innovation en IA et solide compréhension de la façon d’appliquer l’IA générative aux défis commerciaux réels.
* Capacité de gérer de multiples priorités et d’obtenir des résultats de grande qualité dans un environnement dynamique.
* Expérience de travail au sein d’équipes interfonctionnelles et dans des environnements de développement agiles.
* Être à l’aise avec l’ambiguïté et avoir la volonté de prendre des initiatives et de s’approprier les résultats.


 Compétences techniques
   

  

* Expérience avec Copilot Studio, Azure AI Studio et les modèles d’IA générative (p. ex., GPT\-4\)
* Solide compréhension des modèles d’orchestration des agents d’IA, de RAG (génération augmentée de récupération), de modèles d’IA générative (petits et grands modèles de langage) et d’ingénierie de requêtes
* Maîtrise de la plateforme Power de Microsoft (Power Apps, Power Automate et Power Virtual Agents)
* Expérience en développement et en résolution de problèmes dans SharePoint Online, particulièrement avec l’intégration aux solutions d’IA agentique et à la plateforme Power
* Expérience en matière de rôles de sécurité infonuagique et de création d’entités personnalisées
* Maîtrise de Dataverse, des API, des connecteurs et des stratégies d’intégration
* Expérience des méthodes agiles et des pratiques DevOps
* Capacité à programmer en Python et JSON
* Connaissance des plateformes infonuagiques (Azure, AWS, etc.) et des technologies de conteneurisation (Docker, Kubernetes, etc.)
* Familiarité avec l’intégration de ServiceNow et d’Agent Studio de Moveworks (un atout)
* Connaissance d’Azure AI Services et d’Azure AI Foundry (un atout)
* Les certifications telles que Microsoft Azure AI Engineer Associate, PL\-200 ou PL\-400 sont un atout


 Ce poste requiert une maîtrise écrite et orale de l’anglais. La personne retenue devra soutenir ses collègues ou des parties prenantes anglophones d’autres provinces, ou collaborer avec ceux\-ci.

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
**We’re Quandri, our mission is to unlock the world’s insurance data so brokerages and agencies can best serve their clients. Our Renewal Intelligence Platform is designed to help brokerages save time, increase profitability, and drive better outcomes for their staff, clients, and business.** 




  





 We saw 3x ARR growth last year and have plans to continue to grow both revenue and our team this year. Named one of
 
 LinkedIn’s Top Canadian Startups
 
 in 2024, we have already made a big impact on the insurance industry. However, what matters most is making our customer’s lives better one renewal at a time. We want you to be a critical part of that journey! We’re a hybrid company, with ⅔ of our team in Vancouver and the rest distributed. For those in Vancouver, we have an office in Gastown that we expect people to be at three days a week. We understand both the advantages of some flexibility around personal lives, and the positive interpersonal effects of in\-person collaboration.
 



  





 Running a profitable personal lines book of business is harder than ever for insurance brokerages. Market conditions, rising costs, talent shortages, and staffing constraints are just some of the challenges that hinder profit margins, scalability, and exceptional client service. Trusted by 5 of Canada’s top 10 brokerages, Quandri is transforming the renewal process with AI\-driven automation, enabling proactive workflows and delivering data\-driven insights.
 



  





 Today’s renewal process is often reactive, with brokers focusing on clients who request help rather than adopting a proactive, data\-driven approach. Quandri is revolutionizing renewals by offering a platform that uses AI and automation to streamline operations. This allows brokerages to retain more business, enhance client and staff experiences, reduce E\&O risk, and boost sales through upselling and cross\-selling.
 



  





 Are you looking to make an impact in your next role? How about transforming an entire industry? At Quandri, we’re unlocking new frontiers in insurance. To do that, we model our culture as a crew of interstellar astronauts. As Quandronauts, we’re committed to building a company that is diverse and multi\-faceted. We’ve raised venture capital from top US and Canadian investors to help us achieve our mission, and are now scaling to achieve this.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




  





 We're seeking an AI Engineer to lead the development of sophisticated AI applications and intelligent systems. You'll be responsible for integrating foundation models, building AI agents, implementing advanced RAG systems, and creating production\-ready AI applications that deliver exceptional user experiences. This role focuses on applied AI development and building intelligent systems that solve real business problems.
 



  





**What you will do:** 




  




* Design and develop AI\-first applications powered by cutting\-edge foundation models.
* Create and deploy intelligent agents capable of complex reasoning and task execution.
* Build Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems—including advanced graph RAG implementations.
* Develop conversational and multi\-modal interfaces that enable natural, intelligent user experiences.
* Integrate AI capabilities into existing product workflows and help define entirely new product experiences.
* Implement integrations with leading foundation models such as GPT, Claude, Gemini, and more.
* Design and execute fine\-tuning strategies to adapt models to domain\-specific use cases.
* Apply advanced post\-training optimization techniques like Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), constitutional AI, and safety alignment.
* Develop reusable prompt engineering frameworks and systems for automated prompt optimization.
* Combine multiple models and agents into ensembles and multi\-agent systems for complex problem solving.
* Build and maintain vector databases and high\-performance semantic search systems.
* Implement state\-of\-the\-art text embedding techniques and similarity matching workflows.
* Design and build knowledge graphs and graph\-based reasoning engines.
* Architect multi\-step reasoning pipelines and tool\-using agents for dynamic workflows.
* Deliver personalized, context\-aware AI experiences that drive real\-world impact.
* Deploy AI systems into production with strong performance, availability, and reliability guarantees.
* Monitor system behavior and quality with observability tooling and analytics.
* Design and implement robust safety mechanisms including content filtering and model alignment controls.
* Continuously optimize inference cost and latency for scalability.
* Build and maintain automated evaluation systems to ensure quality, safety, and alignment in real\-time.



  





**The right person for this role will have:** 




  




* 3\+ years of experience in AI/ML engineering, applied AI, or related fields
* Strong proficiency in Python for AI application development
* Solid SQL skills for data retrieval and analysis
* Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and their AI services
* Experience with foundation models and LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, etc.)
* Proficiency with AI frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, etc.)
* Knowledge of vector databases (Pinecone, Milvus, pgVector) and embedding models
* Core AI Competencies Experience building RAG systems and knowledge retrieval applications
* Understanding of prompt engineering, few\-shot learning, and in\-context learning
* Knowledge of LLM fine\-tuning techniques (LoRA, QLoRA, full fine\-tuning)
* Experience with text embeddings, semantic search, and similarity matching
* Familiarity with AI agent frameworks and tool\-using language models
* Experience with of AI safety, alignment, and responsible AI development practices



  





**Bonus points if you have:** 




  




* Master's or PhD in Computer Science, AI/ML, Mathematic, or related field
* Experience with graph databases and knowledge graph construction
* Knowledge of multi\-modal AI (vision\-language models, speech recognition)
* Experience with AI model evaluation, red teaming, and safety testing
* Familiarity with edge AI deployment and model optimization
* Experience with conversational AI and dialogue systems
* Contributions to AI research, publications, or open\-source AI projects



  





**Our guiding principles:** 




  




* **Customers at the core.** 
 We put the customer at the center of all we do. At a basic level, we believe business success comes down to talking to customers and building something they want. We don’t listen to customers and just take what they say blindly, but we think critically about it and build what they need. Customers are the core of everything we do, and our business exists to serve them. We prioritize their needs over all else within the company.
* **Move with urgency.** 
 There are times when we need to move slowly and deliberately, but we default to acting fast and with urgency. We slow down when necessary, but this should be a deliberate choice. Businesses become more lethargic as they grow, this principle is designed to fight this fact.
* **Be curious.** 
 We understand the world by being curious and asking why. We aren’t satisfied with surface level understanding, and seek a deeper understanding of why things are the way they are. Don’t take someone’s word for it or the answer “because that’s how we do it.” Understand why and dig deep.
* **Excellence in execution.** 
 We know that what separates good from great is a high level of execution. We commit ourselves to excellence in everything that we do, from delivering an amazing product to writing a great email.
* **Act like an owner.** 
 We’re all owners of the business and act like it. We follow through on commitments, own our results and think long\-term.
* **Fight for simplicity.** 
 The law of increasing functional information states that systems evolve to become more complex over time. At Quandri, we believe there is sophistication in simplicity; as such, we intentionally fight for streamlined solutions and are committed to the uncomplicated.



  





**Compensation and benefits:** 




  




* Compensation range of
 **$145k to $200K** 
 annually
* Employee stock options based on experience level
* Comprehensive health benefits, including Lifestyle Spending Account
* 4 weeks of paid vacation per year
* Work anywhere in the world for 60 days of the year



  





**Application process:** 



* Please submit your resume highlighting relevant experience and include a cover letter explaining your interest in the specific role
* Provide links to relevant projects, GitHub repositories, or publications
* Be prepared to discuss technical projects and problem\-solving approaches in interviews



  





 Quandri is dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. As an equal opportunity employer, Quandri adheres to Canadian labour laws and does not engage in discrimination based on race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or any other status protected under Canadian law.
 



  





 Don’t let imposter syndrome stop you from applying. Great people sometimes don’t have the “right” experience. If you think that you’ll be amazing at this role then we encourage you to apply.

title: Architecte de Solution en Intelligence Artificielle (IA)
description:
CGI est une entreprise mondiale de premier plan dans les services en technologies de l'information et la transformation numérique. Nous sommes à l’avant\-garde de l’innovation, aidant nos clients à intégrer des solutions d'intelligence artificielle qui transforment leurs opérations et favorisent la prise de décisions stratégiques. Nous recherchons un Architecte de Solution en IA pour concevoir et mettre en œuvre des architectures avancées qui exploitent la puissance de l’intelligence artificielle et de l’apprentissage automatique.

**Fonctions et responsabilités**

* Concevoir et développer des architectures robustes et évolutives pour des solutions d’intelligence artificielle et d’apprentissage automatique alignées sur les besoins métier des clients.

  

* Collaborer avec les équipes multidisciplinaires (Data Scientists, Data Engineers, développeurs) pour garantir la livraison de solutions optimisées et performantes.

  

* Diriger la sélection et l’intégration des plateformes, frameworks, et outils d’IA adaptés (TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit\-learn, etc.).

  

* Assurer la gouvernance et la gestion des modèles IA tout au long de leur cycle de vie, en utilisant des outils de MLOps comme MLflow, Kubeflow, ou SageMaker.

  

* Mettre en œuvre des solutions IA sur des environnements cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) en exploitant des services tels que Azure Machine Learning, AWS SageMaker ou Google AI Platform.

  

* Développer des stratégies pour le traitement de données massives, l’entraînement de modèles et l’intégration avec des pipelines d’entreprise.

  

* Garantir la sécurité, l’éthique et la conformité des systèmes IA, tout en respectant les réglementations en vigueur (RGPD, IA responsable).

  

* Réaliser des études de faisabilité technologique et des POC (Proof of Concept) pour valider l’adoption des solutions IA.

  

* Participer activement à la veille technologique et intégrer les dernières avancées en IA dans les projets clients.

  

* Former et encadrer les équipes internes ainsi que les clients pour adopter les meilleures pratiques en matière de développement IA.

**Qualités requises pour réussir dans ce rôle**

* Minimum de 7 ans d'expérience en développement de solutions technologiques, avec au moins 3 ans d'expérience dans l’architecture de solutions IA.

  

* Expertise en IA, apprentissage automatique, et traitement du langage naturel (NLP) ou vision par ordinateur (Computer Vision).

  

* Connaissance approfondie des frameworks d’apprentissage automatique (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras) et des bibliothèques Python (scikit\-learn, pandas, NumPy).

  

* Expérience dans la mise en œuvre de solutions IA sur des plateformes cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) et intégration avec des services tels que Data Lake, BigQuery, ou Azure Synapse.

  

* Compétences en conception de pipelines de données et automatisation via des outils comme Airflow ou Step Functions.

  

* Compréhension approfondie des modèles d’IA responsables et des considérations éthiques dans le déploiement de solutions.

  

* Excellentes compétences en communication pour travailler avec des parties prenantes techniques et non techniques.

  

* Bilingue (français et anglais), avec une maîtrise des techniques de présentation et de vulgarisation.

  

Atouts supplémentaires :  

  

* Certifications cloud (AWS Machine Learning Specialty, Azure AI Engineer Associate, Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer).

  

* Expérience avec des architectures distribuées et des frameworks de calcul intensif (Spark, Dask, etc.).

title: Développeur ou Développeuse en IA générative / plateforme Power
description:
**Aperçu**
 Chez KPMG, vous ferez partie d’une équipe diversifiée et dévouée de professionnels de la résolution de problèmes ayant un objectif commun traduire l’information en occasions pour nos clients et nos communautés partout dans le monde.
   

  

 Nous sommes à la recherche d’une personne dynamique et dotée du sens des affaires pour se joindre à notre équipe à titre de développeur ou développeuse en IA générative / plateforme Power. Ce rôle met l’accent sur le développement d’agents d’IA et d’agents Copilot à l’aide d’outils comme Copilot Studio et Azure OpenAI. La personne idéale comblera l’écart entre les besoins du cabinet et les solutions techniques en jouant un rôle hybride qui combine des connaissances en développement à la gestion de projet et à l’engagement des parties prenantes.
   

  

**Ce que vous ferez**
* Concevoir et intégrer des capacités d’IA générative et des solutions agentiques telles que des agents d’IA à l’aide de Copilot Studio, de la plateforme Power de Microsoft et d’outils connexes
* Développer et gérer des connecteurs, des API et des intégrations d’IA personnalisées à l’aide de systèmes d’entreprise, notamment ServiceNow et d’Agent Studio de Moveworks
* Concevoir, développer et déployer des solutions à l’aide de la plateforme Power de Microsoft (Power Apps, Power Automate, AI Builder)
* Collaborer avec les parties prenantes du cabinet pour recueillir, interpréter et traduire les exigences en solutions d’automatisation intelligente
* Prendre en charge le cycle de vie complet de la solution, de l’idéation et du prototypage au déploiement et à la maintenance
* Veiller à ce que les solutions soient sécurisées, évolutives et conformes aux normes d’architecture d’entreprise


**Ce que vous apportez au rôle**
* Diplôme en sciences informatiques ou formation équivalente.
* Solides compétences en relations interpersonnelles et en communication, et capacité d’interagir avec des utilisateurs professionnels et des équipes techniques.
* Passion pour l’innovation en IA et solide compréhension de la façon d’appliquer l’IA générative aux défis commerciaux réels.
* Capacité de gérer de multiples priorités et d’obtenir des résultats de grande qualité dans un environnement dynamique.
* Expérience de travail au sein d’équipes interfonctionnelles et dans des environnements de développement agiles.
* Être à l’aise avec l’ambiguïté et avoir la volonté de prendre des initiatives et de s’approprier les résultats.


 Compétences techniques
   

  

* Expérience avec Copilot Studio, Azure AI Studio et les modèles d’IA générative (p. ex., GPT\-4\)
* Solide compréhension des modèles d’orchestration des agents d’IA, de RAG (génération augmentée de récupération), de modèles d’IA générative (petits et grands modèles de langage) et d’ingénierie de requêtes
* Maîtrise de la plateforme Power de Microsoft (Power Apps, Power Automate et Power Virtual Agents)
* Expérience en développement et en résolution de problèmes dans SharePoint Online, particulièrement avec l’intégration aux solutions d’IA agentique et à la plateforme Power
* Expérience en matière de rôles de sécurité infonuagique et de création d’entités personnalisées
* Maîtrise de Dataverse, des API, des connecteurs et des stratégies d’intégration
* Expérience des méthodes agiles et des pratiques DevOps
* Capacité à programmer en Python et JSON
* Connaissance des plateformes infonuagiques (Azure, AWS, etc.) et des technologies de conteneurisation (Docker, Kubernetes, etc.)
* Familiarité avec l’intégration de ServiceNow et d’Agent Studio de Moveworks (un atout)
* Connaissance d’Azure AI Services et d’Azure AI Foundry (un atout)
* Les certifications telles que Microsoft Azure AI Engineer Associate, PL\-200 ou PL\-400 sont un atout


 Ce poste requiert une maîtrise écrite et orale de l’anglais. La personne retenue devra soutenir ses collègues ou des parties prenantes anglophones d’autres provinces, ou collaborer avec ceux\-ci.
   

  

**Échelle salariale \- Colombie\-Britannique**

description:
L'ingénieur IA à Avanade est responsable du développement de solutions d'IA évolutives alignées sur une stratégie commerciale et un cas d'avantages. Le rôle sera de travailler au sein d'une équipe pour avoir un impact sur des problèmes du monde réel en fournissant un travail technique d'IA. Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous devrez être passionné par les données et l'IA, un apprenant continu et un solide joueur d'équipe.
